# Tiny EVTX Fixture

`system.evtx` is a small real Windows Event Log fixture used to exercise the
default EVTX parser path for boot/shutdown candidate extraction.

Source:

- Repository: `https://github.com/omerbenamram/EVTX`
- Commit: `38a2d50b21629edb3dd77953a2c02a4b944badf1`
- Original path: `samples/system.evtx`
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0, matching the upstream repository license files
- SHA-256: `60e5fd8f10a3deecd58bd7bee2e03b1308d190fd13b52908be9d576c7f5d6623`
- Size: 1,118,208 bytes

The upstream crates.io package excludes `*.evtx` samples, so this file is
tracked here explicitly with provenance. It is not a private workstation sample.
